description: Domain report: registration date, expiry, registrar, status, and name servers from the official registry (RDAP), plus DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, CAA) and email security (SPF, DMARC policy), with flags for new, expiring, or misconfigured domains. Useful for vetting a company, vendor, or link before trusting it. Not charged for invalid or reserved domain names. Paid via x402; see list_prices.
name: domain_report
title: Domain registration, DNS, and email security
